title: Understand LLM Training
core_invariant: Causal next-token prediction scores token t+1 from the prefix through t. Correct pairs are inputs = tokens[:-1] and targets = tokens[1:]. A one-position shift error can still drive training loss down. Train loss is not downstream quality. Evaluation is invalid when held-out ids appear in train (leak e02). Pretraining, adaptation/post-training, evaluation, and inference are different stages; inference is not a weight update. The teaching model is a (V, V) bigram table, not a production trainer. Predict before every training-system action. Decoding policy and RAG stay closed. Generic WP-137 chart, table, and metric blocks carry the evidence; there is no custom frontend.

stages.title: Frame the system that produces a language model
stages.instructions: Restate the M30 block dataflow. M31 starts V07: tokens → window → shifted (input, target) pairs → next-token NLL → checkpoint → protected evaluation on dataset v07-teaching-corpus-1, seed 3101, teaching bigram table, tokenizer word v06.1. Identify gate evidence: a WP-137 chart of train versus held-out NLL, a table of constructed pairs, and a contamination lineage report. Do not set temperature or retrieve. The generic workbench renders catalogue blocks; do not expect a named trainer page.

stages.title: Predict, train the teaching table, and chart loss
stages.instructions: Complete the experiment cycle on the tiny causal fixture. (1) PREDICT that inputs equal tokens[:-1] and targets equal tokens[1:], that train objective loss falls under seed 3101 / 60 steps, and that held-out true next-token NLL is a different claim from train loss. (2) COMMIT the prediction. (3) EXECUTE / RUN the bounded teaching simulation; emit WP-137 blocks: a line chart of train objective loss, a table of (input, target) pairs, and a metric of held-out NLL, seed, dataset_version. (4) OBSERVE the structured chart. (5) SUBMIT an explanation of any delta. Classify frozen interventions as pretraining, adaptation, evaluation, or inference. Do not download a pretrained model.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Prediction is sealed before execute; the submitted explanation covers the observed chart and why later-mission mechanisms stayed closed.

stages.title: Read tokenize, window, shift, batch, loss, split, checkpoint, eval
stages.instructions: Read M27 encode, shift that uses tokens[1:], eval on the correct alignment, checkpoint split hash. Predict pairs for a short sequence and that leaked eval ids invalidate held-out evidence. Do not inspect an M32 decoder. Submit an annotated system-flow artifact.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: The trace names the teaching dataflow and does not open later-mission internals.

stages.title: Diagnose a one-position shift or held-out leak
stages.instructions: One named fault: train targets equal window[:-1], or copy authored eval id e02 into train_ids while the eval formula stays unchanged. Predict that training loss can still fall. Execute, emit a WP-137 table of first_divergence (pairs versus tokens[1:], or train ∩ eval), and repair alignment or authored train membership from the broken trace. Tokenizer, seed, and steps stay fixed. Submit prediction, discriminator, smallest repair, and regression.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Each failure names one controlled cause; the repair restores the named contract.

stages.title: Map pairs and stages without assistance
stages.instructions: From a blank page, construct pairs for (10, 20, 30, 40), compute a tiny NLL, map pretraining/adaptation/evaluation/inference, and call a shift or leak. Low train loss is not quality. Tutor surfaces stay locked. Emit a WP-137 metric of independent pair arithmetic. Leave learner answers unfilled in the repository.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Independent no-AI reasoning names the teaching contract and a valid repair.

stages.title: Author the V07 training-data and evaluation provenance ADR
stages.instructions: Author the training provenance ADR: dataset version, split lineage, checkpoint identity, adaptation stage, audit metadata, alternatives, owner, status, and date. Do not make decoding claims.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: ADR names a teaching-scale decision, alternatives, and a revisit trigger.

stages.title: Start V07 from a stage-aware checkpoint
stages.instructions: Connect the accepted teaching run to V07: dataset version, split hash, objective, adaptation stage, seed, inference_ready. M32 may decode only after training-time versus inference-time is explicit. Do not retrain the M30 block.

stages.title: Evaluate LLM-training evidence
stages.instructions: Evaluate orientation, loss-chart experiment, shift/leak failure, unassisted transfer, and ADR against the gate contract. Issue PASSED or targeted repair. Do not award completion from train loss alone.
